title: The commit check fails closed when it cannot be sure

evaluations.label: Revocation state cannot be established
evaluations.why: If the check cannot show that the grant is unrevoked, the action does not proceed.

reasons.message: revocation state is 'check_unavailable', so the grant cannot be shown to be unrevoked

evaluations.label: An evidence record named by the proposal cannot be resolved
evaluations.why: Evidence that cannot be resolved is not evidence that is current.

reasons.message: evidence M3W-0417 v9 does not exist

evaluations.label: The run starts after the approval has expired
evaluations.why: An approval is time-bound; a delayed executor does not extend it.

evaluations.label: The time of the revocation check is not known
evaluations.why: A check that cannot be placed before the attempt cannot show the grant was unrevoked then.

value.reason: The producing system did not record this time.

reasons.message: the time of the revocation check (state 'not_revoked') is missing or unknown, so it cannot be shown to precede the attempt

evaluations.label: The admission time of a cited record is not known
evaluations.why: Evidence that cannot be shown to have been admitted by the attempt is not evidence the gateway may rely on.

value.reason: The producing system did not record this time.

reasons.message: the time M3W-0417 v2 was admitted is missing or unknown, so it cannot be shown to have been available at the attempt
PRE-MATCH-PASS is not satisfied: A current three-way match result for the invoice is PASS.

evaluations.label: The issuance time of the approval is not known
evaluations.why: A grant that cannot be shown to have been issued by the attempt is not usable.

value.reason: The producing system did not record this time.

reasons.message: the grant's issuance time is missing or unknown, so it cannot be shown to have been issued by the attempt
